suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Enforce the skill's manual-verification requirement so workers cannot mark followedProcedure=true without transcript evidence of `npm run dev` plus recorded `interactiveChecks` (or explicitly document an allowed exception path).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The fh-scrutiny-fixes rerun review found the same enforcement gap as round 1: the skill requires recorded manual UI verification, but the fix feature handoff still had no `npm run dev`, `agent-browser`, or `interactiveChecks` evidence while reporting followedProcedure=true.
